zones.description: Mid-rise residential кварталы along internal boulevards provide family-oriented housing with access to green courtyards and embankment views.
Higher-density residential towers near metro and bridge connection create a compact transit-oriented edge while respecting the 19-floor height limit.
Retail galleries, shopping and entertainment centre, and office centre positioned near main access roads and pedestrian bridge to activate the waterfront district.
Comprehensive school with sports grounds located centrally for safe walking access from all residential sectors.
First kindergarten integrated into residential courtyard fabric with protected play areas and landscape buffers.
Second kindergarten positioned near the park zone to support family-oriented development and balanced service distribution.
Continuous riverside green corridor preserves public water access, includes recreation lawns, ecological landscaping, playgrounds, and pedestrian/cycling promenade.
Surface parking lots for approximately 2,500 vehicles combined with mobility hub, cycling infrastructure, and direct pedestrian route to metro bridge.

facts: Building coverage remains below 30% of the territory.
Green and open public space occupies more than 45% of the site.
Maximum building height does not exceed 19 floors.
The embankment remains publicly accessible along the Moskva River backwater.
A pedestrian and cycling axis connects the district to the Nagatinsky Zaton metro bridge.
The plan includes one school, two kindergartens, retail functions, and office space.
Residential development is organized as a transit-oriented waterfront neighborhood.
